jobs.title: People Operations Manager, OKRs & Performance
jobs.description: About A1 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. About the Role You will own the systems, processes and frameworks that drive performance across the company. You will lead company-wide OKR planning and review cycles, design scalable performance management processes, analyze organizational data, and ensure our culture and values are consistently reflected in how we hire, evaluate and develop people. You will work closely with leadership across the business to improve execution, increase accountability and help teams perform at their highest level. What You Will Be Doing Own and continuously improve the company's performance management framework. Lead company-wide OKR planning, tracking and quarterly review cycles. Design and implement scalable people processes that improve organizational effectiveness. Analyze people, performance and operational data to identify trends, measure outcomes and recommend improvements. Build dashboards and reports that provide meaningful insights into organizational performance. Define business requirements for HR systems, reporting tools and workflow automation. Partner with leaders across the company to improve team performance and execution. Develop frameworks for performance reviews, calibration, promotions and career development. Drive initiatives that strengthen accountability, ownership and a high-performance culture. Ensure company values are embedded throughout employee programs, performance evaluations and day-to-day operations. Continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and improve the employee experience. Support strategic people initiatives and organizational projects as the company grows. What You Will Need Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in People Operations, People Analytics, Organizational Effectiveness, HR Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting or a related field. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into action. Experience designing or improving performance management frameworks, OKRs or organizational processes. Excellent problem-solving and structured thinking skills. Ability to write clear business requirements and improve operational workflows. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities. High ownership, attention to detail and a bias toward execution. How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions. This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews. Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite. We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process. Our team designs and implements DoorDash's automated support solutions, with the ultimate goal of delivering an outstanding customer experience as reliably and efficiently as possible. About the role Our team is looking to hire a Manager to lead the expansion of support automation in international markets. This Manager will own the end-to-end strategy and implementation of automated support features across new markets — leveraging DoorDash's extensive automation expertise to drive measurable automated resolution rate while building a scalable foundation for ongoing global expansion. This Manager will serve as the S&O Expansion Program Lead: the central DRI for developing DoorDash's international automation rollout plan, owning reporting for North Star metric, and working closely with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and country teams. This role is a great opportunity for someone who wants to operationalize complex, multi-market solutions and have a direct impact on DoorDash's global support strategy What you'll be doing Lead strategy. Define and drive DoorDash's support automation expansion strategy for international markets: determining use cases, prioritization frameworks, and the approach to scaling automations across countries in a repeatable, compliant, and operationally efficient way. Own the metric. Own the goal end-to-end, tracking progress weekly, identifying gaps, and driving corrective action across the cross-functional team. Build the foundation. Build a strong foundation partnering with Product and Engineering to enable feature parity and market customization, and creating the playbook for scaling across new use cases and automation channels. Enable experimentation. Partner with Analytics to design, launch, and evaluate experiments that measure impact and drive ship decisions in alignment with stakeholders. Navigate cross-functional complexity. Identify and manage interdependencies with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Legal, and country leads — ensuring automation strategy is built in alignment with local market requirements, regulatory constraints, and broader business priorities. Communicate and influence. Represent the automation expansion program in weekly business reviews and executive forums, clearly articulating progress, risks, and decisions needed from senior leadership. Requirements You're organized. You thrive in creating structure out of ambiguity — defining clear ownership, milestones, and processes in a complex, multi-team environment. You solve problems from first principles. You're excited to tackle challenges in new markets and resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking. You're analytical. You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL or modeling in Excel to size opportunity, track performance, and inform decisions. You're persuasive. You are an effective communicator — speaking as if you're right and listening as if you're wrong. You can influence across DRIs at all levels, from country leads to senior leadership. You act with urgency. Speed excites you. You move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and hold teams accountable to timelines. You're relentless. You do what it takes to drive outcomes, no matter how many teams or time zones are involved. You have 5+ years of experience in strategy, operations, management consulting, or a related field — and have successfully delivered results in complex, cross-functional environments. Experience in support strategy, automation, or international expansion is a plus. Why Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops

jobs.title: (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (all genders) (2)
jobs.description: Als (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager baust du das operative GTM-Rückgrat: HubSpot als zentrale Revenue-Plattform, automatisierte Sales-Prozesse und die Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb, Marketing und Customer Success. Deine Aufgaben HubSpot-Ownership & Weiterentwicklung: HubSpot ist unsere zentrale Revenue-Plattform und du verantwortest alles, was dahinter liegt: Datenmodell, Custom Objects, Pipelines, Lifecycle Stages, Properties, Workflows und Dashboards. Du baust nicht auf der grünen Wiese, sondern verbesserst gezielt das, was schon steht – und erkennst, wo das Setup an seine Grenzen kommt. PLG und Sales-Assist verbinden: Kleine Betriebe schließen bei uns im Self-Service ab, ab einer bestimmten Größe begleitet Sales. Du baust die Brücke zwischen beiden Motions: ein PQL-Modell, das echtes Kaufinteresse sichtbar macht, saubere Übergänge in die persönliche Betreuung und ein Reporting, das beide Motions getrennt bewertet. Automatisierung & Integrationen: Du identifizierst manuelle Engpässe in Sales, CS und Support – Lead-Routing, Aufgaben, Handoffs, Benachrichtigungen – und automatisierst sie. Dazu gehören die Schnittstellen zu unserem Produkt, dem Data Warehouse und dem GTM-Stack: Custom Integrations über APIs, Reverse-ETL-Strecken und Automatisierungen in n8n. Revenue-Prozesse entlang des Customer Lifecycles: Von Lead-Capture über Scoring und Routing bis zum Übergang ins Sales-Team, und weiter über Onboarding, Adoption, Expansion und Renewal. Du denkst den Prozess über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und stimmst ihn zwischen Marketing, Sales und CS ab. Verlässliche Daten, Reporting & Forecasting: Du sorgst für saubere, konsistente Daten und etablierst wiederkehrende Datenhygiene-Routinen. Darauf baust du Dashboards und KPIs, die als echte Steuerungsgrundlage taugen – damit sich die Führung auf den Forecast verlassen kann, statt ihn aus dem Bauch heraus zu korrigieren. KI im Revenue-Betrieb: Wir betreiben Teile unserer RevOps-Arbeit schon heute über KI: Claude mit MCP-Anbindung an HubSpot, n8n und unser Warehouse. Du treibst das weiter – wo ersetzt ein Agent einen manuellen Prozess, und wo braucht KI-Output eine Kontrolle, bevor er produktiv geht? Enablement & zentrale Anlaufstelle: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle HubSpot- und Revenue-Operations-Fragen. Du dokumentierst, baust Playbooks, schulst das Team und sorgst dafür, dass die Systeme nicht nur existieren, sondern auch genutzt werden. Das bringst du mit Mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Revenue/Sales Operations: Idealerweise in einem SaaS-Unternehmen mit wachsender GTM-Motion. Entscheidend ist nicht deine Erfahrung nach Anstellungsdauer, sondern dass du Prozesse im Gegensatz zum reinen Verwalten spürbar besser gemacht hast. Fundierte HubSpot-Expertise: Du kennst HubSpot nicht als Anwender, sondern als Gestalter: Datenmodell, Custom Objects und Associations, Pipelines, Workflows, Properties, Reporting. Du weißt, wo die native Plattform aufhört und wo du eigene Wege brauchst. Automatisierung, Integrationen & Prozessdesign: Du hast nachweisbar manuelle Abläufe automatisiert und Systeme über APIs verbunden. Webhooks, Custom Integrations und Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Zapier gehören zu deinem Werkzeug – du weißt aber auch, wann native Bordmittel die bessere Antwort sind. Daten- & Analysekompetenz: Du erkennst Lücken in der Datenqualität, bevor sie zum Problem werden, und übersetzt Zahlen in klare Aussagen. Solides Verständnis von B2B-SaaS und GTM: Sales, Marketing, Customer Success und Support: Du verstehst die Mechanik, nicht nur die Begriffe. Du kannst einen Sales Cycle beschreiben, weißt, was einen Forecast belastbar macht, und erkennst, warum ein Prozess, der auf dem Papier funktioniert, im Alltag eines Sellers scheitert. Neugier für KI im Ops-Alltag: Du hast KI schon eingesetzt – HubSpots eigene Features, Claude oder ChatGPT für Analyse, Dokumentation und Datenaufbereitung, oder KI-Bausteine in n8n. Fünf Jahre Erfahrung erwartet hier niemand.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Projektsteuerung & Projektabschluss (m/w/d)
jobs.description: VIGOWATT ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Photovoltaik und Energietechnik mit Sitz in Paderborn. Entscheidend ist für uns weniger deine konkrete Branche als deine Fähigkeit, dich schnell in komplexe Sachverhalte einzuarbeiten und offene Themen konsequent zum Abschluss zu bringen. At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM: 

You will become part of a dedicated and dynamic team that drives Tide's market success in Germany. The Tide Germany team is in an exciting growth phase and unites experts with profound knowledge in the fields of financial services, technology, and local market understanding. As part of this expanding team, you will receive the unique opportunity to help shape Tide's presence in Germany and jointly deliver innovative solutions for small businesses. Partner Credit Services is Tide's SME loan platform. By collaborating with credit partners, Partner Credit Services connects business owners with the appropriate financing – for founders who want to take their business to the next level, for entrepreneurs who are holding their own in a difficult market, and for executives who want to adapt their strategy.

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

  • As a Senior Platform Operations Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of Tide's SME loan platform and the bridge between our sales, product, and engineering teams. Our platform works to match business owners with the most appropriate lenders for their finance applications, and its performance depends on the integrations behind it working reliably and converting effectively.
  • You will own platform-driven revenue and the relationships with the lenders integrated into it. That means knowing our conversion numbers better than anyone, spotting where the platform is leaking value, and turning that insight into product changes and new initiatives that grow revenue and improve the customer experience. It also means owning the operational detail - monthly revenue reconciliation, incident response, and the reporting that leadership relies on to make decisions.
